newsitem.title: USA: Toyota sets mid-year U.S. price increase.
newsitem.headline: Toyota sets mid-year U.S. price increase.

text.p: Capitalizing on strong demand for its products, Toyota Motor Corp.'s U.S. sales arm said Monday it would raise prices on certain 1997 Toyota and Lexus models by an average of 0.3 percent, or $57.
The increases take effect April 10, Toyota Motor Sales USA Inc said.
The Toyota division said price increases of 0.3 to 0.5 percent will affect all Toyota models except Corolla, Supra and RAV4.

An increase of 0.3 percent, or $90, will apply to the Lexus division's ES 300 luxury sedan, and an increase of 0.5 percent, or $250, will apply to the LX 450 luxury sport utility vehicle. Prices of all other Lexus models remain unchanged.
Optional equipment and destination charges will remain unchanged for both divisions.
